prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
System: Regional Dispatch Center ("Juniper", RDC): 24/7 intake/triage/dispatch; incident records; produces Unit Staging Change Card; records authorization, unit-selection reason, routes, capability restrictions (rationale/scope/duration); retains audit evidence under access/retention controls; reviews service measures vs thresholds. Modes: Surge (RDC declares level; on easing Sundial hands over); Degraded Radio (emergency traffic prioritized; voice failure -> approved data channel, log attempt times; reconcile delayed reports, preserve discrepancies). Mutual aid when objectives missed. Actors: Call Taker Mara ("Larkspur"): location/callback/hazards/pediatric data; produces Caller Location Correction Slip; receives Bedside Arrival Receipt. Triage Supervisor ("Copperfield"): priority; sends Pediatric Acuity Note; approves overrides; reviews Duplicate Incident Audit Memo and acuity-risk cases. Regional Medical Director: clinical policy, approves clinical guidance changes; no dispatch authority. Dispatcher. Shift Commander ("Sundial"): sends Mutual Aid Release Form; receives Coverage Gap Bulletin; may restrict capability for unacceptable defect risk; reviews significant events with RMD; retains authority until successor acknowledges. Radio Coordinator ("Mistral"): sends Coverage Gap Bulletin; uses Change Card (channels) and South Access Lane Notice. Fleet Maintenance Cell ("Bluejay"): Battery Swap Voucher; uses Mutual Aid Release Form; preventive scheduling; maintenance records (asset ID, work, parts, return-to-service). Data Quality Officer ("Pebble"): flags defects, never changes priority; sends Audit Memo. Paramedic Crew. Hospital Liaison Desk ("Kestrel"): Bedside Arrival Receipt; capacity; review input protecting info. Emergency Department. Elements: CAD Console (tested vs approved scenarios before change); Ambulance Coordination Platform (queues updates; changes impact-assessed; monitored availability/integrity); Regional Radio Network (checked after maintenance); Ambulance Unit 417; Riverside Trauma Center; North Gate Status Board (North Approach Queue Snapshot); South Gate Status Board (South Access Lane Notice). Requirements: handoff only after ack; release records owner/test evidence/limitations/rollback; audit findings state records, criteria, limitations; findings assigned owner, due date, closure verification; corrective actions verified for effectiveness; recurring issues -> systemic analysis; lessons into procedures/training/maintenance/release criteria.

New part:
S247: The Regional Dispatch Center provides a periodic summary of assurance activities, open risks, and improvement progress to regional oversight.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
